name: gt650
description: Kawasaki GT650, 648 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin. The first application profile. Every value carries its provenance, and most of what a track tune needs is NOT yet known - see docs/UNKNOWN_REGISTER.md (UNK-GT-001..019). This profile will idle and cruise. It is not a track tune until the fuel and ignition tables are measured.

rod_ratio.note: UNK-GT-019: not published. 1.45 is a typical road-stroker value and affects the rod inertia the crank model uses. Measure it before using the crank model for anything but a first guess.

crank_teeth.note: UNK-GT-001: the OEM trigger wheel has not been counted. A 36-1 crank is a common retrofit, NOT a statement about this engine. Count the wheel.

missing_tooth_index.note: which tooth is missing; matters only for a custom profile

tooth_1_angle_atdc.note: UNK-GT-002: TDC is NOT established. This is the angle the ignition table is timed against, and everything here is provisional until a timing light says otherwise.

cam_teeth.note: UNK-GT-003/G-06: the OEM has no cam sensor. Semi-sequential is used instead of sequential, which does not need one. A track build with cam sync would use 3-1 or 4-1.

tooth_1_polarity.note: both conditioners active high; this is how the RACCOON harness presents its edges. A real conditioner may be active low - UNK-GT-004.

input_filter_level.note: start conservative and tighten once the noise floor is measured

injector_peak_a.note: UNK-GT-005: no injector is specified. 4 A is a common high-impedance peak and is a PLACEHOLDER. Injector flow at 4 A is the number the whole fuel model depends on, and it is unknown.

injector_max_duty_pct.note: 80 percent, not 100: a duty ceiling with no headroom is a rule violation by design, and a duty that pins the injector open at part throttle is a hot injector

ignition_peak_a.note: UNK-GT-006: the OEM coil is a single coil with an external driver and RACCOON is not assumed compatible with it. This is a smart-coil current.

ignition_max_dwell_ms.note: needs a thermal and saturation measurement on the actual coil

spark_divider_ratio.note: primary:secondary turns ratio; sets the spark energy

knock_sensor_count.note: none fitted. Knock control cannot arm with a zero count, which is the schema refusing to claim a feature that is not there.

throttle_channels.note: cable throttle, one TPS. DBW is off; a dual-sensor cable throttle with DBW off is refused as a wiring mistake.

lambda_channels.note: UNK-GT-010: the OEM lambda is not established. Closed loop is off, so the ECU runs open loop on a conservative table until a wideband is fitted and measured.

has_kill_switch.note: assumed present because a road bike has one. CONFIRM THE WIRING: the profile assumes it fails safe, and a switch wired the other way is a switch that does nothing.

ignition_driver_topology.note: UNK-GT-006: the OEM is a single coil with an external driver, and RACCOON is NOT assumed compatible with it. A track build would use a smart coil or a wasted-spark pair.

injector_driver_type.note: UNK-GT-005: no injector is specified. If the fitted injector is low impedance it needs a peak-and-hold driver, and a high-z saturation driver on a low-z injector is a destroyed driver.

max_rpm.note: street. A track build raises this, and the hardware has to be rated for whatever it is raised to.

safety_rpm_limit.note: the soft cut, below the limiter

ignition_min_deg.note: hard envelope; the ignition table cannot command outside it
